source.author: verg
source.text: Sic deinde locutus in medium geminos immani pondere caestus proiecit, quibus acer Eryx in proelia suetus ferre manum, duroque intendere brachia tergo.
source.text_original: Sic deinde locutus / in medium geminos immani pondere caestus / proiecit, quibus acer Eryx in proelia suetus / ferre manum, duroque intendere brachia tergo.
source.text_english: Then, having spoken thus, he cast into the midst two boxing gauntlets of monstrous weight, with which fierce Eryx, accustomed to battle, used to bear his hand, and to strain his arms against the hard bull’s hide.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tales, tales ego ducere suetus atque sequi.
reuse.text_original: tales, tales ego ducere suetus / atque sequi.
reuse.text_english: such men, such men am I wont to lead and follow.
